name: Black Bean & Pineapple Hawaiian Pita Pizza
instructions: Peel and slice the onion into thin half rings.
Wash and dry the pineapple. Cut skin off pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
In a medium bowl, combine garlic, tomato sauce, and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
To assemble, top the pitas with a thin layer of tomato sauce, cheese, red onion, pineapple, and black beans. Place on a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Remove from oven and top with cilantro leaves. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
